tickets.title: Site Notes — chip entry + suggestion chips (Piece A+B)
tickets.description: Replace the single free-text notes blob with discrete add/delete note chips, plus job-type-aware suggestion chips to elicit high-value facts (access, listed status, condition, hazards, waste). Accuracy win is elicitation, not format. Deferred from pre-launch (June 12, 2026) — reworks the most-used input screen + its auto-save (regression risk during launch crunch); validate with real users post-launch. See SITE_NOTES_UX_PLAN.md (Piece A+B).
acceptance_criteria: Notes entered as discrete chips with add/delete; soft cap ~10 guidance, ~15 hard ceiling
Job-type-aware suggestion chips pre-fill the input (not auto-commit)
Option-1 data shape: persist notes as joined string (no migration, backwards-compatible)
Prompt renders notes as a bulleted list under DETAILED NOTES
Auto-save persists the uncommitted input buffer (no data loss vs the blob) — KEY RISK
Colocated tests for add/delete, soft cap, suggestion pre-fill, join-on-save, uncommitted-buffer persistence
